ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a "schematic map of the geographical locations of Malaysia and Indonesia" in Southeast Asia: Malaysia is located on the Malay Peninsula and in the northern part of Kalimantan Island, and Indonesia is composed of many islands such as Sumatra, Java, Kalimantan, and Sulawesi; the region is roughly located between 90°E and 150°E, the equator passes through the vicinity, and overall it is close to the equator and has numerous islands. The question asks "which characteristic Southeast Asian monsoon paddy agriculture does not have"; the candidate characteristics include: large-scale farm operation, large amount of water conservancy engineering, high yield per unit area, low commodity rate, and low level of mechanization. According to the general characteristics of monsoon paddy agriculture, large amount of water conservancy engineering, high yield per unit area, low commodity rate, and low level of mechanization all conform; this agriculture is usually mainly smallholder operation, not large-scale farm operation. Therefore the characteristic it does not have is large-scale farm operation.
